about_blocks.text: About Into Action Recovery Sober Living

Into Action Recovery Sober Living is a men's sober living house at 1622 East 12th Avenue in Vancouver, just off Commercial Drive. It is the Second Stage of Into Action Recovery Society's program: a place to live after residential treatment, not a treatment centre itself. There are no daily therapy groups and no clinical program here; what the house offers is structure, rules and other men in recovery.
about_blocks.html: Into Action Recovery Sober Living is a men's sober living house at 1622 East 12th Avenue in Vancouver, just off Commercial Drive. It is the Second Stage of Into Action Recovery Society's program: a place to live after residential treatment, not a treatment centre itself. There are no daily therapy groups and no clinical program here; what the house offers is structure, rules and other men in recovery.

about_blocks.text: Most men move in after finishing Into Action's First Stage at one of its houses in Surrey, Burnaby or Abbotsford. The centre says that by this point residents usually have significant clean time, often more than 100 days. BC211 adds that men who did not come through First Stage can also apply if they have a strong support network and experience staying clean, and that referrals are accepted from people on methadone maintenance.

The centre says that by this point residents usually have significant clean time, often more than 100 days. BC211 adds that men who did not come through First Stage can also apply if they have a strong support network and experience staying clean, and that referrals are accepted from people on methadone maintenance.

about_blocks.text: Life in the house has clear expectations. Residents stay clean and sober, do a daily chore, keep a curfew, accept random drug testing and go to support meetings, at least four a week according to BC211. A counsellor comes to the house once a week. In the rest of the week, men work, look for work or go to school, which is the point of this stage: practising ordinary life while the routine is still there.

centre.faq_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Into Action Recovery Sober Living

faqs.question: Is Into Action Recovery Sober Living a treatment centre?

answer_blocks.text: No. It is a sober living house, the Second Stage of Into Action's program. Residents have usually finished residential treatment already, and the house provides structure, house rules and peer support rather than a daily treatment program.
answer_blocks.html: No. It is a sober living house, the Second Stage of Into Action's program. Residents have usually finished residential treatment already, and the house provides structure, house rules and peer support rather than a daily treatment program.

faqs.question: Who can live at the Vancouver sober living house?

answer_blocks.text: Adult men in recovery. Most come from Into Action's First Stage residential program, and Into Action says most residents have over 100 days clean by this stage. BC211 notes the program also takes men with a strong support group and previous sober time, including men on methadone maintenance.

faqs.question: What are the rules at Into Action's sober living house?

answer_blocks.text: Stay clean and sober, keep the curfew, do a daily chore and go to support meetings. BC211 lists a minimum of four support meetings a week and willingness to take random drug tests.

faqs.question: Can I work or go to school while living there?

answer_blocks.text: Yes. That is what this stage is for. Many residents work, look for work or attend school while they keep up meetings, chores and the curfew.

faqs.question: Is there any counselling at the sober living house?

answer_blocks.text: Some. Into Action's program page lists weekly on-site counselling and daily support meetings for Second Stage residents. There is no daily group therapy or medical care at the house.
